context: Ads-manager style dashboard for Shopify DTC brands to run measurable referral campaigns (Loop Lab v1) with high-density widgets, clean attribution trust states (pending, verified, reversed, flagged), campaign builder, share links generator, conversion tracking, reward liability ledger, and abuse review queue.

colors.archetype: The Performance Pro & High-Contrast Swiss Data

layouts.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-5 shadow-sm

motion.transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease

accessibility.contrast: WCAG AA compliant, APCA verified dark text on light backgrounds

image_urls.description: E-commerce analytics & store management workspace preview

instructions_to_main_agent: Build Loop Lab v1 ads-manager style dashboard using React.js (.js files), Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI components.
Implement Workspace & Campaign Management with campaign list, fast-create wizard (audience rules, conversion rules, reward rules, budget caps).
Include Tracked Share Links generator with WhatsApp-first sharing, copy variants, and channel stats.
Include Conversion Tracking table with attribution trust states (pending, verified, reversed, flagged) + demo mode simulator + CSV fallback.
Include Reward Liability Ledger with multi-currency totals and pending/approved/reversed status.
Include Analytics Dashboard with funnel (shares -> clicks -> conversions), CPA vs paid acquisition metrics.
Include Abuse Controls review queue (self-referral detection, coupon leakage flags, suspicious conversion review).
Ensure all interactive elements and key informational items have data-testid attributes.
Ensure solid or glassmorphic header (never transparent) with clear navigation.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
